description: This file defines the PayPeriod entity class for the OrangeHRM project, mapping to the 'hs_hr_payperiod' database table. It includes properties for pay period code and name, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PayPeriod
classes.description: Entity class representing a pay period with code and optional name, mapped to the 'hs_hr_payperiod' database table.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the pay period, if set.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the pay period.
